name: VK International Public JS Com
summary: VK International PJSC engages in the development of Internet communications and entertainment services. It operates through following segments: Social Platforms and Media Content; EdTech; Technologies for Business; and Ecosystem Services and Other Business Lines. The Social Platforms and Media Content segment comprises services and products aimed at the development of social networks, creation, and management of content. The EdTech segment includes the group’s online education platforms with educational courses and programs. The Technologies for Business segment is represented by VK Tech which includes cloud platforms and data management solutions, corporate communication services, tax monitoring platform, and other corporate software. The Ecosystem Services and Other Business Lines consists of Mail.ru Email, Cloud Mail.ru, and other products such as RuStore app store and VK Play gaming platform. The company was founded by Yuri Bentsionovich Milner and Dmitry Grishin on May 4, 2005 and is headquartered in Moscow, Russia.
